senses.gloss: m. (אדר; Assyr. idrânu, v. Fred. Del. Hebr. Lang. p. 24; cmp. חֵדֶר) an enclosure, chamber, esp. dark alcove, bed-room.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 37:9">Targ. Job XXXVII, 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 26b:13">Meg. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>איד׳ דהוה וכ׳</he> a room where the corpse was placed before burial.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 7a:11">B. Bath. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>השתא משוית לי איד׳</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>והשתא אינד׳</he>) now thou makest my (formerly open) compartment a lightless alcove.
<cite ref="Taanit 25a:1">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>עיילא לאינ׳</he> she went up to the bed-room.
